samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Implement a parallel to serial converter with MSB to LSB order. Every four input bits are converted to a serial one bit output.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating the availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="s0">0</parameter>
        <parameter id="s1">1</parameter>
        <parameter id="s2">2</parameter>
        <parameter id="s3">3</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <line>reg [3:0] data;</line>
        <line>reg [1:0] cnt;</line>
        <line>reg valid;</line>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <line>assign dout = data[3];</line>
        <line>always @(*) begin</line>
        <line>i0: if (cnt == 3) begin</line>
        <line>i1:     data = d;</line>
        <line>i2:     cnt = 0;</line>
        <line>i3:     valid = 1;</line>
        <line>i4: end else begin</line>
        <line>i5:     cnt = cnt + 1;</line>
        <line>i6:     valid = 0;</line>
        <line>i7:     data = {data[2:0], data[3]}</line>
        <line>i8: end</line>
        <line>i9: end</line>
        <line></line>
        <line>always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin</line>
        <line>j0: if (~rst_n) begin</line>
        <line>j1:     cnt <= 0;</line>
        <line>j2: end</line>
        <line>j3: end</line>
    </implementation>
</module>
